title: BOILED OYSTER PLANT
instructions: --Scrape a bunch of oyster plants, dropping into cold water to which a little vinegar has been added. Cut in small pieces and boil in salted water until tender. Season with butter,  pepper and cream.  Cream may be omitted if desired.
